concepts.learning_objective: Identify economic activities as those performed in exchange for money or money's worth.
Explain the meaning of money's worth and of a market where goods and services are exchanged.
Identify non-economic activities as those done out of love, care, gratitude and respect, not for income.
Classify the activities of a person as economic or non-economic depending on whether they involve payment.

topics.title: Types of economic activities and ways of payment

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between a salary and a wage as forms of payment for work.
Explain a fee and payment in kind as other ways in which people are paid for work.
Calculate the value added when something is transformed into another form and sold.
Recognise which activities and professions create money-related value.
Explain seva as selfless service, such as langars, done without expecting anything in return.
Describe how community efforts like Swachh Bharat Abhiyan and Van Mahotsav add value to society.
